name: FlareForward Bond — Lot 2 (10,000 FLR)
description: Backs the FlareForward validator bond on Flare. Holders receive an equal per-NFT share of any distributions the lot makes from what the validator actually earns, paid on-chain through a distribution contract anyone can verify. Distributions are not guaranteed in amount or timing. Funds bond at lot close; there is no redemption, and unclaimed rewards travel with the NFT. Measured performance published at ftso.flareforward.com/nft.
